sections.title: History and Memory: Remembering the Past in the Modern World
sections.description: This course is designed for first-year students from all fields. Using case studies from around the world, the class will explore the nature of memory in different contexts; its relationship to history; and its role in shaping ethnic identities. We will survey different modes, not only of remembering and memorializing the past but also of forgetting it. How and why are some sites and artifacts preserved, and what role does their preservation play in the present? What is the relationship between popular media and history and memory? The seminar is primarily discussion based, with occasional mini-lectures by the instructor.
